Which property of copper explains why it is classified as a transition element?
A
Copper can be bent into different shapes.
Copper forms Cu2+and Cu+ions.
B
C
Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
D
Copper has a low density.

options.label: A
options.text: Copper can be bent into different shapes.

options.label: C
options.text: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
